analysis.overall: A mix of smooth stretches and tricky shifts today, highlighted by a late-night spike requiring a site change and a prolonged low during your morning fast.

events.title: Post-dinner correction dip
events.description: A rising trend around 7:00 PM prompted a few stacked correction doses, which eventually pulled glucose down to 67 mg/dL around 9:00 PM.

events.title: Late-night spike and site change
events.description: Glucose climbed steeply up to nearly 200 mg/dL around 10:30 PM. Swapping out your pump site and insulin helped restart absorption and safely brought numbers down overnight.

events.title: Extended morning low
events.description: During your morning fast, readings drifted down into the mid-50s and stayed stubbornly low for a few hours before slowly recovering.

events.title: Smooth midday recovery
events.description: Glucose comfortably leveled out around 90-120 mg/dL and remained steady through the start of the afternoon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on basal settings during fasting hours, as morning fasting kept your readings lower than target for several hours.
